title: Longest active streak
description:
To measure adoption, a customer wants each user's longest run of consecutive active days.

You are given `days`, an unsorted list of day numbers on which a user was active. It may contain duplicates. Write `longest_streak(days)` that returns the length of the longest run of consecutive day numbers.

Sorting works, but try for O(n).

**Example**

```
longest_streak([10, 4, 11, 20, 12, 5])
# 3   (days 10, 11, 12)
```
hints: Put all the days in a set.
A day starts a streak only if `day - 1` is not in the set. Count forward only from those starts.
Each day is visited at most twice this way, so the total work is O(n).
